text:
Alice Ramos: Quick heads-up — planning HarborGrid private deployment swap this Friday 2026-03-13 02:00-03:30 UTC (maintenance window). Posting runbook + asks for approvals and any blockers. TL;DR: move tenant from Dedicated slice -> Private VPC, pin model to v2.3.1-quant6, canary 10% for 30m, rollback criteria below. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/harborgrid-swap :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Confirmed with account — customer blackout: no writes 01:45-03:45 UTC, they allow read-only. They requested KMS key preservation (they manage key).

Ben Kwon: SRE note — need +20% GPU headroom for canary. Current private pool autoscale looks fine but I'll reserve 2 extra nodes for the window. Also suggest lowering canary to 5% for first 10m then 10% for 20m to be safer.

Marco Li: infra checklist ready. Commands to pin model in service-control:
```
redwoodctl deploy pin --tenant harborgrid --service inference --model v2.3.1-quant6 --timeout 900
redwoodctl traffic shift --tenant harborgrid --service inference --to private --percent 10 --duration 30m
```
Make sure `--model` matches model-catalog id exactly.

Alice Ramos: Updated plan: canary 5% x10m then 10% x20m. Rollout steps in runbook. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >500ms for 5m OR telemetry enrollment shows model-quality drift (semantic regression) flagged by evals. If any trigger -> immediate shift back to Dedicated pinned at v2.2.9 and abort.

Priya Patel: Compliance quick check — audit logs must be preserved and exported to their S3 bucket during change window. OpsBot, can we confirm export on?

OpsBot: @Priya Patel export task scheduled: audit-export/harborgrid -> s3://harborgrid-logs/2026-03-13, retention 90d.

Ben Kwon: On-call triage rotation: Ben (lead), Marco (infra), Sami (runtime) for the window. Notified on-call page.

Marco Li: Also validating network egress rules — private VPC route already has harborgrid CIDR allowed. Will run connectivity smoke at T-15m: `curl -sS https://harborgrid.internal/health` on private control plane from jumpbox.

Alice Ramos: Release notes snippet to include in customer email: "Model pinned to v2.3.1-quant6 for improved throughput and stable quantization; no functional changes to API. Canaries run 5%->10%. Expected outage: none; read-only during migration per customer request."

DeployBot: deploy:harborgrid queued by Alice Ramos for 2026-03-13T02:00:00Z. Canary plan: 5% @ 02:00 for 10m, 10% @ 02:10 for 20m, full shift @ 02:30 if all green.

Priya Patel: +1 from account side, customer TPM on standby during window.

Ben Kwon: +1 from SRE after reserving nodes. I'll monitor telemetry during canary.

Marco Li: +1 infra. I also attached a short escalation step summary in the runbook (phone numbers included).

Alice Ramos: Approvals collected: Priya, Ben, Marco. Requesting @Ops lead or Eng Release approver to sign off for schedule and rollback thresholds.

OpsBot: Release approver needed: run `approve-release --thread 2146789012` in release-cli.

Alice Ramos: Approver ping: @Sonia (release-approvals) — can you take a quick look?

Sonia (not in participants list): Sorry, I'm OOO today until 18:00 UTC but I can remote-approve the schedule if the documented rollback ops are followed.

Alice Ramos: Noted — Sonia remote-approval condition accepted. Final check: any infra or legal blockers?

Priya Patel: Legal signed the data flow exemption for vault access.

Ben Kwon: No further infra blockers. I'll run the final capacity test at T-60m.

Marco Li: Final preflight checklist added to runbook and I pushed a small fix to the canary traffic script (see PR #4821).

Alice Ramos: Great — locking window and kicking to DeployBot. I'll post a brief customer-facing note 1h before start. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
